text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear paragraphing and transitions like \"To begin with,\" \"Secondly,\" and \"Lastly\"","quality":"organization","description":"This captures how well an essay is structured into a coherent sequence of ideas."},{"evidence":"specific examples such as \"science class\" and \"educational scavenger hunts\"","quality":"concrete support","description":"This captures the use of specific, relevant details to develop and justify claims."},{"evidence":"sentences that stay readable throughout with only minor errors","quality":"sentence control","description":"This captures how consistently the writer can produce clear, controlled sentences."},{"evidence":"controlled formal phrases like \"I strongly concur\" and \"beneficial\"","quality":"academic diction","description":"This captures the use of more precise and appropriate word choice for an argumentative essay."},{"evidence":"expanded reasons with explanation in each body paragraph","quality":"development","description":"This captures how fully the writer elaborates on ideas rather than stating them briefly."}]}
